name: seen
description:
seendb turns your video recordings (meetings, tutorials, screen recordings) into a knowledge base Claude can query. Upload videos or connect the places they already live — Dropbox, Google Drive (including Meet recordings), or Frame.io. seendb indexes each video into a timecoded transcript, keyframes, on-screen text and visual descriptions.

Once connected, Claude can list and find your videos, read outlines and transcripts, search across your whole library for specific moments (returning exact timecodes), view the actual frames at any timecode, and import new videos from direct links.

Useful for meeting recordings, tutorials, screen recordings and any footage you'd rather ask questions about than scrub through. Videos stay private to your workspace, are never used for model training, and can be deleted at any time. The free plan includes 30 minutes of video per month.

_published_faq.name: How do I add seen to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add seen to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.seendb.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the seen MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: seen provides these MCP tools: video_analysis, video_analyze, video_frames, video_import, video_list, video_outline, video_search, video_status, video_transcript, and video_upload.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to seen?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to seen in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
seen requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
